description: Ministry of   Megapolis & Western Development   - The  Planning & Building  Regulation for  the  Care Areas of the Metro  Colombo  Development Region
reasoning: This gazette primarily concerns the generalization of a specific building regulation (Regulation 38 of the Planning & Building Regulation 2008-2020) to a wider geographic area. It is a regulatory action taken under the authority of the Urban Development Authority Law.
